_doc: Part heights above the board's top face and pin depth below its bottom face, mm, by footprint name (the part after 'lib:'). From the parts' STEP models (kicad-cli pcb export step) and their LCSC 'Height - Seated (Max)', rounded up. A footprint not listed takes 'default'. 'note' says where a number came from.

CONN-TH_XDJK-0271-1650.note: stacked RCA pair; STEP model sits 13.5 mm low and 6.1 mm in, corrected

SW-SMD_4P-L5.1-W5.1-P3.70-LS6.5-TL_H1.5.note: TS-1187A actuator top at 1.5 mm, 1.6 N

OPTO-TH_IRM-3638T.note: IRM-3638T standing, lens forward at the front edge, ~5 mm up (Lite worker, 15:03)

CAP-TH_BD10.0-P5.00-D1.0-FD.note: core C5/C6/C311, Rubycon 50PX470MEFC10X20 (LCSC C88733): seated max 20 mm; leads clipped to 2.5

IND-SMD_L8.5-W8.0_PCC-M0854M.note: core amp filter, PSPMAA0805-100M (C2962885): library model 4.0, 0805 series 5.0 max

CONN-TH_P5.00_KF301-5.0-2P.note: KF301-5.0-2P (C474881): LCSC height above board 10 mm; library model pins 3.5

SW-TH_EC11E1820402.note: EC11 vertical encoder, shaft tip: library model (H24.5); Alps lists EC11E1834403 with a 20 mm flat shaft, so the knob's bore takes 20-24.5
